text: ふだんは　ちじょうで　エサをさがすが　ごくたまに　きのえだに　とびのって　きのめを　ついばんだりする。

structure.jp: ふだんは　ちじょうで　エサをさがすが
structure.en: usually it looks for food on the ground, but

structure.jp: ごくたまに　きのえだに　とびのって
structure.en: very occasionally it hops onto a tree branch and

structure.jp: きのめを　ついばんだりする。
structure.en: does things like peck at leaf buds

patterns.name: 〜たり
patterns.explanation: たり plus する gives an action as one example of what it does, 'does things like'. ついばんだりする = 'will sometimes peck'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form joins one action to the next, like 'and then'. とびのって = 'hops on and...'

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a sentence half means 'but'. さがすが = 'it searches, but...'
